title: A/P Detail: 2,000 document rows download as PDF, headings not counted
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • On {Date-A} A/P Detail has exactly 2,000 open lines across its buckets (plus bucket rows, subtotals and the Totals row), and on {Date-B} exactly 2,001.
    For example: a prepared test organization (see the note).
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/P Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Set the as-of date to {Date-B}.
  4. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: 2,000 document rows.
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads: bucket rows, subtotals and the Totals row are not counted.
  • Step 3: 2,001 document rows.
  • Step 4: "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." and nothing downloads.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R9: “The row count for the export limits is the number of customer or vendor rows (Summaries) or document rows (the other four), not counting headers, subtotals or the Totals row.”
  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
